topics.title: Getting Started with Histeria
topics.summary: Learn how to get your first transactional email sent using Histeria's API or SMTP interface.
topics.content:
Histeria is a transactional email infrastructure platform designed to make triggering application emails reliable and straightforward. Whether you are building a SaaS product, an ecommerce store, or a mobile app, Histeria provides a simple HTTP API and SMTP bridge.

### Step 1: Create an API Key
Navigate to your Histeria Dashboard and create an Organization API Key under **API Keys**. Store the raw key securely — it is shown only once.

### Step 2: Create a Template
Build a template using the **Visual Builder** or **Code Editor**. Save it as an Active template version with a slug like `welcome-email`.

### Step 3: Trigger an Email
Make a POST request to `/v1/emails/send` with your `x-api-key` header.

topics.title: API Authentication
topics.summary: Understand organization API key authentication for triggering application emails.
topics.content:
All requests to Histeria public email endpoints must include an organization API key passed via the `x-api-key` header.

### Request Header
```http
x-api-key: ck_live_your_secret_key
```

### Security Best Practices
- Store API keys securely in server-side environment variables (`.env`).
- Never expose API keys in client-side code or public Git repositories.
- Create separate API keys for Production and Staging environments.

topics.title: Managing API Keys
topics.summary: Create, name, set expiration for, and revoke organization API keys from your dashboard.
topics.content:
Histeria API keys belong to your Organization. You can manage multiple keys with granular names and optional expiration dates.

### API Key Properties
- **Name**: Custom descriptive label (e.g. `Production Store App`).
- **Prefix**: Identifiable key prefix (e.g. `ck_live_...` or `ck_test_...`).
- **Expiration**: Optional automatic key expiration date.
- **Status**: Active or Revoked.

### Key Revocation
If a key is compromised, revoke it immediately from the Histeria Dashboard. Revoked keys stop accepting send requests instantly.

topics.title: Send an Email
topics.summary: Trigger a transactional email using POST /v1/emails/send.
topics.content:
The primary public API endpoint triggers an email for asynchronous delivery.

### Request Payload Parameters
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | Yes | Template ID or slug (e.g. `order-confirmation`) |
| `to` | string | Yes | Recipient email address |
| `cc` | array[string] | No | Optional CC recipient email addresses |
| `bcc` | array[string] | No | Optional BCC recipient email addresses |
| `subject` | string | No | Optional subject line override |
| `data` | object | No | Dynamic template variables |

### Response (202 Accepted)
```json
{
  "id": "email_98ab71c2",
  "status": "QUEUED"
}
```

topics.title: Email Templates
topics.summary: Build reusable email templates using the Visual Builder or HTML Code Editor.
topics.content:
Histeria templates separate email design from application code. Templates support two creation workflows:

1. **Visual Builder**: Drag-and-drop text blocks, buttons, images, and container layouts.
2. **Code Editor**: Direct HTML authoring with full control over CSS styles and dynamic markup.

Both workflows result in Histeria Templates ready to be triggered via `templateId` or slug.

topics.title: Template Dynamic Variables
topics.summary: Inject dynamic application variables into email templates.
topics.content:
Templates support dynamic variables using double curly brace syntax. ### Syntax Example ```html

Hello {{customerName}}

Your order number #{{orderNumber}} is confirmed.

``` When sending an email via POST `/v1/emails/send`, supply values in the `data` object: ```json { "templateId": "order-confirmation", "to": "user@example.com", "data": { "customerName": "Sarah", "orderNumber": "ORD-7749" } } ```

topics.title: Template Versioning
topics.summary: Safely update templates with immutable versions and current active selection.
topics.content:
Avoid breaking live application emails during template edits. Histeria maintains version history for every template.

### Version Workflow
- Create draft versions while editing design or layout.
- View complete version history.
- Set a specific version as the **Current Version**.
- Activate the template. Applications using the `templateId` automatically use the designated Current Version.

topics.title: SMTP Integration
topics.summary: Configure SMTP settings to send email through Histeria without changing application API code.
topics.content:
If your application framework already relies on standard SMTP (e.g. PHPMailer, Nodemailer, Rails ActionMailer, Django email backend), you can route emails through Histeria's SMTP relay.

### Organization SMTP Settings
- **Host**: Configurable SMTP host server
- **Port**: Standard TLS/SSL ports (587 / 465)
- **Authentication**: Organization SMTP Username & Password
- **From Address & Name**: Default sender configuration
- **Reply-To**: Optional reply routing

topics.title: Email Timeline & Logs
topics.summary: Audit every email record with step-by-step event history and delivery status.
topics.content:
Every email sent through Histeria generates a clear timeline log.

### Available Filter Criteria
- Delivery Status (`QUEUED`, `PROCESSING`, `SENT`, `DELIVERED`, `BOUNCED`, `OPENED`, `CLICKED`, `FAILED`)
- Template ID / Name
- Recipient Email
- Date / Timestamp Range

### Individual Email Record Inspection
Each log record displays queue time, send time, provider message ID, delivery timestamp, event history, tracking stats, and HTML preview.

topics.title: Email Tracking & Analytics
topics.summary: Understand recipient engagement with open status, open count, click count, and timestamps.
topics.content:
Histeria tracks post-send activity for sent emails.

### Tracked Attributes
- **Open Status**: boolean open indicator
- **Open Count & Timestamps**: First opened time, last opened time, total opens
- **Click Count & Timestamps**: First clicked time, last clicked time, total clicks
- **Delivery Timestamps**: Exact timestamp of provider delivery acceptance
- **Bounce Timestamps**: Timestamp and reason code for bounced emails

topics.title: API Error Codes
topics.summary: High-level HTTP status codes returned by POST /v1/emails/send.
topics.content:
Histeria returns standard HTTP status codes for API responses.

| Status Code | Message | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `202 Accepted` | Email Queued | Request accepted and queued for delivery |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid API Key | Missing or revoked `x-api-key` header |
| `404 Not Found` | Template Not Found | Specified `templateId` does not exist or is inactive |
| `422 Unprocessable` | Validation Error | Missing required fields (`to`, `templateId`) |

topics.title: Usage Quotas & Billing
topics.summary: Monitor monthly email volume, template usage, and team member seats.
topics.content:
Your organization's dashboard provides real-time visibility into usage metrics for your current billing period.

### Tracked Quotas
- **Emails Sent**: Current count vs monthly plan limit
- **Emails Remaining**: Calculated quota balance
- **Templates Created**: Count vs plan template limit
- **Organization Seats**: Active team members
